title: BGP/MPLS VPNs
summary: Describes a method by which a service provider with an IP backbone can offer VPNs to its customers, using BGP to distribute routes and MPLS to forward packets. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 4364.

eli5.summary: A big network company can let many customers share the same wires while each customer sees only their own private network.

questions: how do service providers build vpns with bgp and mpls
